meta.direction: Studio. Rail, timeline, pane in one white shell on a warm canvas; agents identified by tint; black is the action colour; state is a chip.
meta.note: Screen inventory, workflows, nouns and rules are the packet's. Light only. Pastel marks with ink glyphs, ink text everywhere, one bright dot for state. Departures from visual-theme.md are listed in the README.

color.note: Light only, cool only. No orange, amber or rust anywhere. Chips have no coloured fill; state is one small dot on a neutral chip: violet live, green pass, red fail. Agents are pastel marks with a soft glyph of the same family. Text is always ink or grey. Black is the one action colour.

tokens.name: surface-base
tokens.usage: The canvas behind the shell. Cool off-white.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: The shell and every pane. Cards inside the timeline are tiles on this, never cards on cards.

tokens.name: surface-inset
tokens.usage: Composer box, soft pills, neutral chips, typed cards that are not an agent's, the active rail row.

tokens.name: surface-overlay
tokens.usage: Sheets: scope preview, launch preview, recovery. The only surface with shadow-card.

tokens.name: surface-selected
tokens.usage: A selected row. Selection is a shifted surface plus heavier type, never an outline.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Pane separators and tile borders. Never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Titles, body, chip text, every glyph on a pastel mark, the black action pill.

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Meta, timestamps, section caps, chip glyphs. 5:1 on white.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Disabled pill text and provisional streaming only. Never a placeholder.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: The one primary control: black pill, send, active phone nav.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on action.

tokens.name: signal-live
tokens.usage: The live dot, the unread dot and the unread count. Soft violet, the accent every reference shares. A mark only; never a fill, never text. The packet's orange was rejected as a colour decision.

tokens.name: mark-pass
tokens.usage: The pass dot. A mark only.

tokens.name: mark-fail
tokens.usage: The fail dot. A mark only.

tokens.name: fail-text
tokens.usage: Destructive pill text on white only. 5.6:1.

tokens.name: diff-added
tokens.usage: Added diff line, always with a plus gutter glyph.

tokens.name: diff-removed
tokens.usage: Removed diff line, always with a minus gutter glyph.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Alias of ink. 2px at 2px offset on every focusable element.

tokens.name: agent-blue-tint
tokens.usage: Mark fill for center, always. The glyph on it is agent-blue-glyph, a soft medium hue of the same family, never black.

tokens.name: agent-blue-glyph
tokens.usage: Glyph colour on agent-blue-tint. Tone on tone, soft. Never used as text.

tokens.name: agent-violet-tint
tokens.usage: Mark fill for the project agent, always. The glyph on it is agent-violet-glyph, a soft medium hue of the same family, never black.

tokens.name: agent-violet-glyph
tokens.usage: Glyph colour on agent-violet-tint. Tone on tone, soft. Never used as text.

tokens.name: agent-mint-tint
tokens.usage: Mark fill for task agent tint 1. The glyph on it is agent-mint-glyph, a soft medium hue of the same family, never black.

tokens.name: agent-mint-glyph
tokens.usage: Glyph colour on agent-mint-tint. Tone on tone, soft. Never used as text.

tokens.name: agent-pink-tint
tokens.usage: Mark fill for task agent tint 3. The glyph on it is agent-pink-glyph, a soft medium hue of the same family, never black.

tokens.name: agent-pink-glyph
tokens.usage: Glyph colour on agent-pink-tint. Tone on tone, soft. Never used as text.

tokens.name: agent-sky-tint
tokens.usage: Task agent tint 2. Glyph is agent-sky-glyph.

tokens.name: agent-sky-glyph
tokens.usage: Soft glyph on agent-sky-tint. Never text.

tokens.name: agent-teal-tint
tokens.usage: Task agent tint 4. Glyph is agent-teal-glyph.

tokens.name: agent-teal-glyph
tokens.usage: Soft glyph on agent-teal-tint. Never text.

type.note: Cal Sans by cal.com under the SIL OFL 1.1, shipped in fonts/. Cal Sans UI for titles, labels, chips and controls; Cal Sans Text for bodies. IBM Plex Mono for data. Both Cal Sans families carry tnum and zero.

families.text: "Cal Sans Text", "Cal Sans UI", system-ui, sans-serif
families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The greeting on the phone home and the sign-in heading. Two-tone: grey lead-in, black payload.

styles.name: room-title
styles.usage: The room crumb in the header. The project prefix in ink-secondary, the room in ink.

styles.name: item-title
styles.sample: Confirm the invoice receipt after delivery
styles.usage: A typed card's subject line and a speaker's name.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: A budget or count set large. Always tabular.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Reproduced. The receipt is written before the send is confirmed.
styles.usage: Messages, card prose, pane prose. 15px because the references run a touch larger than the packet's 14 and the composer reads better for it; recorded as a change.

styles.name: quote
styles.sample: Retries must be idempotent end to end.
styles.usage: A human's exact decision words, with a hairline left rule in ink.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Timestamps, facts rows, hints. Set in ink-secondary.

styles.name: caps
styles.usage: Section labels in panes and sheets, rail group heads. Real uppercase text, never CSS-generated.

styles.name: kicker
styles.usage: Record kind labels on the older component previews. Kept for compatibility with caps.

styles.name: data-strong
styles.usage: A reason code as the subject of a sentence.

spacing.note: 4px scale. Cards breathe more than the ledger did; the timeline is still dense.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Chip inner padding, glyph-to-word gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Message vertical padding, gaps between chips and pills.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card inner padding on phone, list row padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card inner padding, shell gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Pane and timeline inner inset.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Minimum target size. Section gaps.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Avatar and agent mark size, sheet inset.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Large mark, round controls, composer send.

tokens.name: focus-ring-width
tokens.usage: Focus ring width.

tokens.name: focus-ring-offset
tokens.usage: Focus ring offset.

radius.note: Round, in three sizes, and a pill.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: The shell, sheets, phone frames, big cards on the canvas.

tokens.name: radius-tile
tokens.usage: Typed cards inside the timeline, the composer box, inbox items.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Agent marks, rail rows, fields, small buttons.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills, chips, avatars, the phone nav.

tokens.name: border-hairline
tokens.usage: Pane separators and typed-card borders.

shadow.note: One shadow, on sheets and phone frames only.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Sheets over the shell and the phone frames. Never on a tile inside the timeline.
